title: Dungeon Tactics: Idle, Incremental, Autobattler
description:
Dungeon Tactics is an idle dungeon auto-battler with a tactical twist. Distribute your team of adventurers between the frontline and backline and send them into battle in the dungeon!

Features:Unlock new heroes with different stats and behaviors.Unlock characters with different stats and roles within the team.

Passively improve the heroes rank!As you defeat enemies, the characters on the team (and alive) will receive experience with which they will rank up and gain new skills.

Mark up to 3 upgrades as objectives to see their cost during the game.No more memorizing or jotting down costs; mark them and you'll see them constantly.

Customize your team.You have 16 adventurers to distribute in a team of up to 6. Will you create a balanced team? Or will you prioritize a tankier frontline? Should you include a support or more DPS?

Advance through the upgrade tree.Explore all the skills through the upgrade tree, culminating in infinite upgrade slots for those who want to go even further!

Always on topPress the "Always on top" button and place it in a corner of the screen while you work, browse, play, or whatever you want.
description_short: An incremental idle dungeon auto-battler. Set up your team of adventurers and send them to fight. As they gain experience and learn new skills, you unlock upgrades and recruit new characters. Set it on the corner of your screen while you work, browse, game or anything you want.
